messages.content: 你能使用函數'employee.fetch_data'來為一個名為'Tech Solutions'的公司中ID為12345的員工提取'個人資訊'、'工作經歷'、'工資單'和'出勤'的數據嗎？然後，你能為同一家公司中ID為67890的另一個員工重複同樣的過程嗎？

function.name: employee_fetch_data
function.description: Fetches the detailed data for a specific employee in a given company. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

employee_id.description: The unique ID of the employee.

data_field.description: Fields of data to be fetched for the employee (Optional).
